capabilities: Generate images from a prompt and insert them as embeds at the cursor
Edit existing PNG, JPG or WebP vault images with a text instruction
Choose aspect ratios (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4) for generated images
Configure the output folder for generated and edited images
Select models (Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Qwen Image 3, Seedream 5.0 Pro) with an API key
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free tier is limited: 1K output with a watermark and about two images per day; image editing requires an API key. Editing uploads the image to Kavel's CDN.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate or edit images from text prompts without leaving the note or managing external services.

relations.evidence: This plugin sends your prompt to kavel.ai to generate images.

summary: AI image generator that creates images from a prompt into the current note and edits vault images with one sentence, powered by Kavel without an API key.
